LIMAHURST QUEBECMORE JR

Incident page for this loss

Name: CPT Quebecmore Limahurst, Jr.
Reason: aircraft lost or crashed
Unit: 21 SOS
Status: Killed In Action from a loss on 03/01/1971; duty: Pilot.
Service: U.S. Air Force; reserve component
Country: Laos
Aircraft: CH-53C tail number 68-10931
Short Summary: Lost an engine to fire inserting troops in northern Laos; it crashed into trees and exploded. Only the pilots were US casualties.
Military grid coordinates of event: TG635243
Primary cause: Hostile Fire
Burial information: SAMPLE MEMORIAL PARK, ANYTOWN
